label: sparse, diffuse original-phase unit, weakly tied to input digit 2
explanation: Active on about 1% of steps. 83% of activation mass falls in the original-input phase (never at t=0, rarely at <DEL>), with peaks at t=1-2 and at late original positions 7-8. It fires more in sequences with many digits. The strongest single cue is the input digit 2 (9x lift, 36% of mass), followed by l and the other digits, plus history cues (prev_tok 2, prev2_tok q, first_tok 2/q/g). Still, input 2 in the original phase has only 17% precision, and the best predicate tried (dev F1 about 0.21) adds no coherent structure. Disjunctions of token cues raise recall to about 0.56 but precision falls to about 0.11. Some copy-phase activations happen near the end of long sequences. Activation seems to depend on a combination of tokens that no simple predicate captures.
